body.Job title: Server-Side GTM + GA4/BigQuery Audit & Fix for Shopify eCommerce
body.Job description: We are a Romanian digital marketing agency looking for a long-term tracking partner to work with us as a subcontractor, behind the scenes. This first project is for one of our clients, a Romanian eCommerce business, running on Shopify. The situation Server-side tracking and GA4 are currently managed by another vendor. A recent audit surfaced data quality problems, so the client is moving these two areas to a new partner. We take over in Q4 2026, with go-live on 1 January 2027. Assume you will receive little or no documentation from the previous vendor. Current stack Shopify, GA4 with BigQuery export, Google Tag Manager (web container), a server-side GTM container on a vendor-managed first-party subdomain, Google Ads, TikTok pixel, Klaviyo, Microsoft Clarity, plus a consent layer. Scope 1, server-side tracking Audit the existing server-side container and GTM setup. Fix what the audit finds. Document the full architecture (tags, triggers, variables, data flows) so the client owns it. Test and validate every change before it touches production. Monitor data integrity after go-live. Scope 2, GA4 audit Full audit of the GA4 configuration: events, conversions, custom parameters, acquisition source/medium, BigQuery integration. Reconcile GA4 against BigQuery and fix the causes of any discrepancy. Deliver a prioritised remediation plan. Report on data quality on an agreed cadence. Acceptance criteria the client set Zero critical errors in server-side validation. Zero duplicate transactions. Source/medium attributed for at least 99% of traffic. experiment_id and variant_id present on all relevant events. GA4 versus BigQuery discrepancy within normal limits. Every production change needs a documented, tested rollback. Hard constraint No production changes during Q4 peak campaigns without explicit client approval. All fixes are validated in staging first. What we need in your proposal 1. A fixed price for phase one: audit of server-side tracking, audit of GA4 and BigQuery, remediation plan, architecture documentation. 2. A separate estimate for implementing the fixes, once the audit defines them. 3. Your hourly rate for ongoing maintenance and monitoring after go-live, or a monthly retainer. 4. How many working days you need for phase one, assuming access is granted immediately. How we work You work inside our accounts, under our agency's name. The client relationship stays with us. We handle all client communication, you handle the technical work. We expect clear written documentation and a non-disclosure and non-circumvention agreement. Please skip the generic proposal. Tell us about one setup you took over from another vendor, what was broken, and how you proved it was fixed.
